topic: Replicating historical traffic data for facility
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on retrieving and comparing session traffic data for a specific facility (33548) and company (7897), specifically needing to replicate production traffic from August 1, 2024, through the present date. Multiple SQL queries were reviewed and adjusted.

Initial attempts using `device_session_agg_ml_2_history` showed limitations. A revised query was provided for review, focusing on historical data up to September 5, 2024, using `agg_version in (4)`.

It was noted that the prediction model matched existing data until August 22, 2024. Furthermore, it was observed that after a certain point, the model might not have been calculated for this facility. A second query targeting `device_session_agg_5` was also provided to compare historical metrics.

The conversation concluded with an update regarding future data loading plans.
decisions: The team reviewed multiple SQL queries to replicate session traffic history.
action_items: Follow up on the status of future data loading/model application (to be decided next year).
